narr: A cold front, combined with tropical moisture from Tropical Storm Eta produced flash flooding.
ev: There were reports of two feet of water on Shore Drive. Several vehicles were stalled.
NC DOT reported flooding and a washout on Indian Heritage Rd near Benny Rd. Flash flooding was also reported on Wilkins Rd near Howell Rd. More flooding occurred on Lamb Rd near Long Rd.
